turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend starting off in Phoenix? I hope you're feeling completely back to normal after that bout of flu.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling 100% recovered, thank goodness. My Saturday is off to a very nice, slow start. I actually bypassed my roommate's espresso machine today and made myself a big, warm mug of sweet hot cocoa instead.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ooh, a cozy hot cocoa sounds like a wonderful way to ease into a Saturday morning! Did you have a relaxing day planned after that?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I lounged around for a bit and then met up with some friends to eat a late breakfast-lunch combo at a local cafe. It was really nice to sit on their patio and catch up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds lovely. Going out for weekend brunch is always such a treat. Did Tom join you guys, or did he have other plans today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He had some errands to run this morning, so he couldn't make it to the restaurant. But we're planning to meet up later tonight. We might actually go out salsa dancing if we both have the energy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, salsa dancing sounds like the perfect way to spend a Saturday night, especially now that you've got your energy back!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, absolutely! Being sick was so frustrating, so I'm really excited to get out on the dance floor and move around.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! Night shifts at the ER are demanding enough, so having your full health and stamina back must feel amazing. Have you had any time for your sourdough baking lately, or have you been focusing on resting?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually fed my starter yesterday! I'm planning to prep a loaf tomorrow so I can bake it on Monday. I've really missed the process of making bread.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great! There is nothing quite like the smell of fresh sourdough baking. It sounds like you have a wonderful, balanced weekend ahead of you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I really do. I'm going to rest up a little bit now before I get ready to meet up with Tom. I'll catch up with you later!
